name: Westmont Montessori School

geo.coord_source: BC Ministry school-location dataset 2025/2026 (DataBC geocode of the registered address)

description: Montessori school from early learning through Grade 12 on a 143-acre coastal parkland campus west of Victoria. Montessori methodology to Grade 8, project-based, design-thinking high school (Grades 9–12) graduating Dogwood students. Group 1 independent school.

attributes.philosophy: Montessori through elementary and middle school; high school described as 'project-based learning experience, tackled through the model of design thinking', with nature-based campus learning.

legal_status.label: Independent school, Group 1 (Independent School Act, B.C.)
legal_status.authority: B.C. Ministry of Education and Child Care — Independent Schools Branch

attributes.curriculum: B.C. curriculum ('Ministry Recognized Curriculum') delivered through Montessori methods; project-based high school.
attributes.qualifications_offered: B.C. Certificate of Graduation (Dogwood) — Group 1 schools with Grades 10–12 must meet provincial graduation requirements; Grade 12 graduations reported by the school.

tuition.notes: Totals per year incl. tuition, capital fee $800, supplies and supplementary fees: Early Years $14,739; K $14,808; Gr 1–3 $13,123; Gr 4–6 $13,723; Gr 7–8 $16,778; Gr 9–12 $18,852 (tuition component $16,317). Sibling discount 10%.

attributes.additional_fees: Registration $250 (one-time, per family); refundable family bond $5,000; volunteer levy $500 if hours unfulfilled; uniform est. $300–500.
attributes.admission: Tour, online application with records, mandatory student visit; inclusion-support capacity limited for 2026-27.
advantages: Rare full K–12 Montessori-rooted pathway ending in a Dogwood
Large natural campus; mild south Vancouver Island climate
limitations: High school is project-based rather than strictly Montessori
attributes.qualifying_reason: Private Group 1 school; Montessori continues well beyond early childhood (to Grade 8) with a project-based high school; tuition 2026-27 and register confirmed.
